name: TechnicalHimanshu ChatConnect
author: Technical Himanshu

sections.description:
TechnicalHimanshu ChatConnect is a powerful WhatsApp chat plugin for WordPress that adds a floating chat button with a customizable popup form, helping you connect with customers instantly.

It allows users to send structured messages directly to WhatsApp with dynamic fields such as name, email, order ID, message, and page URL.

The plugin focuses on simplicity, clean UI, and a smart message builder that automatically removes empty fields and maintains proper formatting.

It is ideal for customer support, sales inquiries, and fast communication without requiring any external API.

Why TechnicalHimanshu ChatConnect?

Unlike other chat plugins, ChatConnect focuses on clean UI, smart message formatting, and zero API dependency. It ensures fast performance while giving full control over chat behavior and user input.

Features

  • Floating WhatsApp chat button with popup form
  • Direct WhatsApp chat integration (no API required)
  • Smart message builder with dynamic placeholders
  • Automatically removes empty fields from messages
  • Live message preview in admin panel
  • Enable/disable form fields (name, email, order ID, message)
  • Business hours with online/offline status indicator
  • Mobile and desktop chat button customization
  • Page-level display control (homepage, posts, pages, products)
  • Custom chat icon upload
  • Lightweight and fast performance (no external API)

Message Template Variables

You can use the following variables in your message template:

  • {name}
  • {email}
  • {order_id}
  • {message}
  • {page_url}

Example Template

Hello Support Team

Name: {name}
Email: {email}
Order ID: {order_id}

Message:
{message}

Page URL:
{page_url}

Use Cases

  • Customer support via WhatsApp
  • WooCommerce order queries
  • Lead generation and quick contact
  • Sales and inquiry handling
  • Direct communication without forms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/technicalhimanshu-chatconnect directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ChatConnect menu in admin.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number and configure settings.
  5. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WhatsApp API?

No, it uses the official WhatsApp click-to-chat feature (wa.me). No API required.

Can I customize the message format?

Yes, you can fully customize the message template using placeholders.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, it is fully responsive and includes mobile-specific customization.

Can I control chat availability?

Yes, business hours can be enabled to show online/offline status.

Does it slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance with minimal scripts and no external API calls.
